# Section motion presets

Timing and transform values for each section's animation, one file per area.

## What's here

- `hero.js`, `awards.js`, `card.js`, `organizations.js`, `work.js`, `background.js`, `project-header.js`, `text-split-reveal.js`
- `presets.js` - re-exports them all

## How it connects

- Each file builds on the defaults in `../motion.js`.
- They live here rather than beside each section because molecules and atoms use them too.
